technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term momentum (RSI-9, MACD, PPO) conflicting with intermediate-term weakness (RSI-14, moving average structure, Ichimoku); moderate confluence but elevated risk from overbought conditions and negative accumulation metrics.

fundamental.summary: NI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 36 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (364.48), flat yield curve recession signal, rising dollar headwind, and moderate earnings binary risk (36 days) create a highly unfavourable macro environment for utilities trading.
